body.statement: cutover is a portfolio demonstration. Its customer is fictional, and public NHTSA vehicle complaints stand in for that customer inbox. It is not affiliated with NHTSA or any vehicle maker, it makes no safety determination, and it is not for safety, legal or regulatory use. It never closes a complaint: it routes one to a team or sends it to a person. Its costs are shadow prices from public list prices.
